text:
sam: quick sync on degrade-handshake and quotas across regions — want a short decision path.
ellie: short options: (A) admission centralizes all decisions, (B) schedulers decide from hints, (C) hybrid: admission returns small signed blob (decision, soft budget, generation, expiry) and schedulers do smoothing.
toni: hybrid wins for me. central is easy to reason about, but adds latency. local reduces tail but makes telemetry harder.
maria: hybrid needs region-aware budgets otherwise eu + us could double-spend a tenant's soft budget. propose admission returns per-region budget + global cap.
sam: agree. API sketch: POST /admission/v1/check {tenant_id, tokens, context(region, model)} -> response blob string (decision|budget|budget_window_s|generation_id|expiry_s|model_variant_hint|fallback_mode|risk_score). blob should be HMAC-signed.
ellie: failure modes: if admission times out, scheduler consults tenant fallback_mode (permissive|conservative) and a short probation (N tokens / M seconds). enterprise tenants default to conservative.
toni: telemetry: emit admission_decision_total{decision,tenant,region,generation_id} and scheduler_enforcement_total{outcome,tenant,region,decision_origin}. include chosen_variant in low-cardinality form. ops-bot: filed INFRA-1024 for metrics schema.
maria: implementation plan: 2w basic blob + cache + conservative fallback; 6w add generation_id, region budgets, smoothing lib, model downgrade path; Q2 run chaos tests and risk classifier prototype.
sam: small library for schedulers with leaky-bucket & variant-selector; keep identical semantics across languages. also prefer highest generation_id on races.
ellie: security: sign blobs and rotate keys; expiry_s bounds replay. deployment: admission/feature/degrade-blob -> staging. deploy-bot: queued (sha b7e9a2).
sam: ok owners: ellie update RFC, maria+toni prototype smoothing/config push, sam implement verifier lib, ops wire dashboards. closing unless objections to region-scoped budgets?
toni: no objections.
ellie: great, will update RFC and ping reviewers.
